description: This file handles saving user signatures for the SuiteCRM application. It initializes a UserSignature object, retrieves or creates a new signature record based on request parameters, updates its properties, saves it, and then outputs JavaScript to refresh the parent page and close the window.

classes.name: UserSignature
classes.description: Represents a user signature, with methods to retrieve and save signature data.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches an existing user signature record from the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current user signature object to the database.
